'''Concussion sticks''' were chemical explosive weapons that could be easily disguised as [[Code cylinder/Legends|data probes]] or similar items. Concussion sticks kept two chemical elements separate which were mixed when the concussion stick struck a solid object. Around fifteen [[Standard second|seconds]] after activation, the stick detonated, generating a concussion blast. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Sessian Armaments]] produced the [[Concussion Stick Model 1-79]].
